subject.why: The illustration clearly depicts the glossy red heart-shaped balloon with its white curling ribbon and tiny pink bow as requested.

category.why: The balloon floats freely in the air without any ground plane against a centered concentric ring pattern, matching category 1 requirements.

clean.why: There are no text elements, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The balloon and ribbon are well-centered with ample, balanced margins on all sides and no cutoffs.

colour.why: The bright red balloon contrasts strongly against the warm, saturated sunny yellow concentric background.

detail.why: The form is clean and uncluttered with no noisy micro-textures or excessive details.

style.why: The smooth 3D rendering, soft glossy sheen, and chunky stylized shapes fit the game's casual art style shown in the references.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (100% of the background); planned yellow
